mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which depress corporate earnings expectations and drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 8.5 (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.5%) indicates an active monetary easing response to labor market weakness, which triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE > 8.5% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market recovery (HOUST > 600,000 units), consumer confidence and construction activity support economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 600 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO > 95) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 95 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A nonfarm payrolls level exceeding 132,000 thousand (132 million) indicates a robust labor market, which supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 132000 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 225), the Federal Reserve is expected to raise interest rates, which increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 225 (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high housing starts (HOUST > 600) and strong real personal consumption (RSAFS > 380,000 million) indicates robust consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 600 and RSAFS > 380000 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).
